name: Panel example — two conditions, Prolific parameters, a completion link
notes: Shows recruitment and conditions. Open it the way Prolific does:
The Prolific ID never enters session.json: it is saved separately in
identifiers.json and replaced by a keyed pseudonym on processing. Each
participant is assigned arm A or B at random (the seed is logged); arm A
sees scene_left, arm B its mirror image. The completion link appears only
once the data has been saved. Replace EXAMPLE00 with your study's code.

disclosure.secondary_use: Analysed by the named research team only. Not sold, and not shared outside the team without a further, separate agreement.
disclosure.contact: Replace this with the investigator and the route to the ethics board before running anyone other than the developer.
